screen: Welcome, Q3 How do you settle up, Q4 Who does the math (the three scene heroes)
issue: The scenes are not die-cut stickers on onboarding: the slot crops them to a rounded rectangle, so the mint ground runs straight to the box's left, right and bottom edges with no white border (measured on welcome-dark: mint #a4d4c5 meets the #0f1413 canvas directly at the sides and bottom). The ground reads as a mint colour plate behind the people, the exact thing Trevor asked to remove; the white border only exists along the top silhouette. Rendering the files on their own (scenes/*.svg with the app's sticker filter) gives a proper border all round, so it's the placement that clips it.
fix: In the onboarding scene slot (Scenes.jsx / the .ob-scene box) stop cropping: draw the scene with preserveAspectRatio meet (not 'xMidYMax slice') inside a box inset by 3x the sticker radius, drop overflow:hidden and border-radius on the scene wrapper, so the filter region holds the whole border on all four sides.

screen: Art sheet: Rabbit game sticker (Choose a game list, side games sheet)
issue: The rabbit's face is see-through: games/rabbit.svg has only ink and pink fills, no cream body, so in dark the head is the dark card showing through an ink outline (a black face with a white ring). In light it only works because the card is white.
fix: Fill the head inside its ink line with BALL #fbf7ec in src/art/games/rabbit.svg (same treatment fix2 gave the see-through balls), and re-check the ears' inner white.

screen: Thin detached strokes on every sticker: bulb rays (Settings Help shape card, Suggest something), podium trophy rays, hot streak, coin flip, bell, megaphone, tumbleweed, hammer swoosh, Vegas and Shamble motion lines
issue: Short loose strokes (rays, speed and sound lines) get a soft grey-white glow instead of a crisp die-cut edge: the blur-then-cut filter can't reach full white around a 2px stroke, so each ray sits in a fuzzy halo. In dark the bulb looks like it's glowing and Shamble's speed lines turn into blurry white blobs. In light they leave a grey smudge.
fix: In ArtFile.jsx StickerFilter build the edge with feMorphology operator='dilate' radius=r on SourceAlpha (then a 0.5 blur for antialias) instead of feGaussianBlur + feFuncA slope 16, or raise the slope to about 40 so thin strokes cut crisp. Alternatively join rays into the main silhouette in the files.

screen: Trophy cup (paywall hero) and podium trophy
issue: The cup's handle loops are solid white inside (pixel inside the left handle on paywall-dark is #ffffff), so the handles read as white discs, not open loops; the podium trophy's handles do the same. Trevor asked for no white islands between handles where the background should show.
fix: Punch the handle holes out of src/art/spots/cup.svg and podium.svg as evenodd holes, widened to more than twice the sticker border so the filter doesn't fill them.

issue: Trevor's note 2 named this one: the gap between the thumbs-up ball's legs is still filled white (the legs sit closer than twice the border, so the sticker fill bridges them). In dark it's a white slab between the legs.
fix: Move the legs apart in src/art/spots/agreed.svg (or thin them) so the gap is wider than about 2x the border at 120px, and make sure the gap is transparent in the file.

issue: Grey smudges sit inside both bicep curls: the small hollow loops are half-filled by the sticker filter, leaving blurry grey patches (clear in dark, faint in light).
fix: In src/art/spots/bragging.svg either fill the inner arm loops with cream or open them wide enough to cut cleanly.

screen: Q4 Who does the math (scorecard scene)
issue: Small white dashes float under the table top between the table legs: leftover cream islands in the scorecard scene that the background should show through.
fix: Delete the stray cream fragments under the table in src/art/scenes/scorecard.svg (or cut them out as holes).

screen: Avatars: Ball buddies and critters (name step picker, art sheet)
issue: Several hats are cut off by the avatar circle: the snapback and tour cap brims on the right, the backwards cap brim on the left, the cowboy brim on both sides, the cone's tip and the viking's horns at the top, the propeller, the fishing lure; among critters the albatross wing and the worm-burner's ball. The README asks for the hat inside the circle, and the new ink outline stops at the clip, so it looks unfinished.
fix: Scale each buddy's drawing to fit the circle (about 88% with the hat inside) in those files, or clip only the backdrop disc and let the hat overflow the circle in BuddyArt.jsx.

screen: Game stickers in the Choose a game cards (onboarding step 1, setup)
issue: The game stickers have very different visual sizes in identical slots: Match play is a thin strip of two small balls about a third the height of Skins, Vegas and Sixes are wide and short, and Banker and Wolf fill the box. The grid looks uneven.
fix: Crop each src/art/games/*.svg viewBox to its content box with the same padding, or add a per-game optical scale map in GameArt.jsx so each sticker has about the same visual weight (about 40px tall).

screen: Hand-drawn game art (Stroke play, Nines, Dots, Aces and Deuces, Bingo Bango Bongo, Long drive, Calcutta)
issue: Seven games still use the old flat hand-drawn art (a pie chart for Nines, a dot grid, a thin-line club), which clashes with the brush-line stickers beside them. Stroke play's scorecard sits next to Stableford's star on onboarding's first question.
fix: Draw the seven in the brush style as games/<id>.svg, or until then reuse the closest spot (card for Stroke play, coinflip for Aces).

issue: The winner on the share card is the old thin-line hand-drawn ball on a ground-shadow ellipse with a floating crown whose ochre fill vanishes into the ochre band, and no sticker border. The Banker sticker on the band is also bare (no border) and only about 36pt. It's the one place the old art style is still the hero.
fix: In ResultsArt.jsx / the share card draw the winner from the buddy's file (BuddyArt via ArtImage) inside <Sticker>, swap the crown for spots/goldcrown.svg, drop the shadow ellipse and give the game sticker its sticker border.

screen: Teal-backdrop avatars on the dark canvas (beanie, crown, viking, wizard, eagle, banana)
issue: The teal backdrop #1a3a3a is nearly the dark canvas #0f1413, so these avatars lose their circle and read as a head floating on the page.
fix: Give .avatar a 1px inset ring rgba(255,255,255,.14) in dark (or only when the backdrop is teal).

issue: Yellow-orange fringe specks are left on the grass tips under the lone ball (export colour fringe, like the handshake had).
fix: Remove the gold/peach sliver paths along the grass ink in src/art/spots/loneball.svg.

issue: A small grey speck sits inside the ring above the flame. The hollow ring also gets a white border inside and out, so in dark it reads as a double white target ring around the ball.
fix: Delete the speck in src/art/spots/hotstreak.svg. Consider dropping the ring (the flame and ball read alone) since the filter doubles it.

issue: In the crowd the snapback's long black brim runs across the next buddy's face, cutting through its eyes; the four heads overlap so much the group reads as a jumble at this size.
fix: In the crowd layout (Spot crowd / SpotArt) space the heads about 10% wider and put the snapback buddy last (rightmost) or flip it so the brim points out of the group.

issue: The sticky header (title, six-link nav, theme toggle) takes about a third of each viewport, and card text scrolls under it with no background edge, so each card's file name is cut mid-line.
fix: Make the art sheet header non-sticky, or keep only the Light/Dark toggle sticky on a solid background with a hairline bottom border.

screen: All set for a two-player group
issue: Sam's avatar in the summary card is the chef hat, but the crowd above shows a visor and a snapback, so 'your buddy first' isn't true here. The picture of 'your group' doesn't include you.
fix: In the All set crowd pass the organizer's chosen or auto buddy as the first head for every group size, the two-player branch included.

screen: Name step: buddy picker selected state
issue: The selected buddy gets a thick ink ring in light, but in dark the ring is ink on the dark canvas and disappears, so only the small cream check badge shows which one is picked.
fix: Make the selected-avatar ring use var(--ink) with a dark-theme value of the cream text colour (or a 2px ring in --text) so it shows in both themes.

screen: All set: the ready list, and the paywall's Free forever list
issue: The check discs (All set rows, the paywall's Free forever list and What Pro adds icons, What's new Shipped ticks) are a bright kelly green that isn't in the brand palette; nothing else on these screens uses it, so they shout louder than the CTA.
fix: Point the check colour at an existing token: ink discs with a cream tick in light and cream with an ink tick in dark, or the deep teal #1a3a3a. Change the shared .check / --ok token rather than each screen.

issue: The crowd is centred but the ALL SET eyebrow and title below it are left-aligned, while every payoff step centres its eyebrow and title under centred art. The crowd is also only about 150pt wide in a tall empty slot, small next to the 200pt heroes on the other steps.
fix: Centre .ob-all-set eyebrow and title (text-align:center) to match the payoffs, and size the crowd to the same 200pt hero width.

issue: 'Settling up: Mostly don't' gets the same green check as the other rows, which reads as a thumbs-up for not settling.
fix: Use the check only as 'answered'. Swap it for a quiet dot, or drop the checks and keep the rows as a plain summary.

issue: The two age answers are content-width chips of unequal width that don't fill the row, styled unlike every other choice in onboarding (full-width cards with a radio).
fix: Make them a two-column equal-width segmented pair (grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr) at the 56px choice-card height, or reuse the choice card with a radio.

issue: Scrolled content slides under the back button and progress bar with no background or fade: the top of 'What does your' is sliced off under the bar, and the All set crowd's hats are cut by it.
fix: Give the onboarding top bar the page background plus a 16px fade (mask-image or a ::after gradient), like the scroll fades the play screens got.

issue: The right caption ('payments, and it's square') wraps to two lines while the left is one, so the big 3 sits about 12pt higher than the 6 and the two halves don't line up.
fix: Align the numbers to a shared baseline (grid rows: diagram / number / caption with align-items:start) or shorten the caption to 'payments, square' so both fit one line.

issue: The struck-through 'You' beside each stamp is very light grey at about 11pt, so the before half of the joke barely reads, especially in light.
fix: Set the struck 'You' in --text-2 (not --text-3) at 15px so the strike-through reads.

screen: Join link on a new phone (pick your seat)
issue: The Skins title leads with the Phosphor coins glyph from the welcome tags, not the Skins game sticker used for the same game everywhere else, and the invite has no illustration at all.
fix: Use GameArt for the invite's game (40px sticker) in place of the glyph.

screen: I'll do it later: Up next for a new organizer
issue: The header avatar is a viking in the light run and a cowboy in the dark run for the same brand-new organizer, so the auto buddy isn't stable (it changes between loads).
fix: Seed autoBuddyFor with the player's stable id, not Math.random or a per-session value, and persist the pick on first use.

screen: I'll do it later: Up next for a new organizer
issue: 'Three steps' step 2 'Start a round' has no chevron and only points at the button above, and 'Get a round going' under More ways repeats the same job, so the first screen has three ways to start. The tee sticker in the hero also crowds the title column.
fix: Drop step 2 (or make it tappable like 1 and 3) and give the hero art a fixed 96px column so the title wraps before it.

issue: Each detail row carries a bordered pill ('Not sure yet', 'Any course', 'Group picks') plus a chevron, so the value looks like its own button inside a tappable row.
fix: Show the value as plain --text-2 text before the chevron (no border), the way Settings rows show values.

issue: Bad wraps: Yearly's line breaks as '($4.17 / a month)', and Day 14 leaves 'Two taps.' alone on a line.
fix: Wrap the price parenthesis in a nowrap span, and add text-wrap:pretty to the timeline and plan sublines.

screen: Choice cards and plan cards, selected
issue: A selected choice gets a pink fill, pink 2px border and pink check disc, so every question screen has a big pink block that isn't the button to tap (the brief: pink only on the one thing to tap).
fix: Selected state in ink: 2px --ink border, white card, ink check disc with a cream tick (cream border and disc in dark); keep pink for the primary CTA.

issue: The radio rows look inverted: unselected options are filled beige with a white circle and the selected one is a plain white card with an ink border, so at a glance the two unpicked rows look 'on'.
fix: Make unselected rows the plain card with a hollow hairline radio and the selected row the 2px ink border with a filled ink radio (cream in dark); no beige fill.

screen: Confirm sheets (Start over, Erase all data)
issue: The light scrim turns the cream page a sage-olive grey (sampled rgb 137,143,138), exactly the muddy band the brief warns about, and Cancel is cream-filled here while other secondary buttons are white with a hairline.
fix: Use a warm ink scrim (rgba(10,10,10,.32)) for .sheet-backdrop instead of the greenish one, and give the sheet's Cancel the shared secondary button style.

screen: Butter tags in dark (paywall Save 40%, plan link Leads and Maybe)
issue: The butter tag's dark variant is a dark olive-brown (sampled rgb 58,49,22) with butter text, which reads as a dirty brown chip on the dark cards.
fix: Set the dark .tag-butter background to the butter itself at full strength (#f5e4b0 with ink text) or to rgba(245,228,176,.16) on a neutral, not the mixed brown.

screen: Paywall from Settings and from Season
issue: The Today step says the next round is set up and the group link is ready, but this paywall was opened from Settings and Season, where nothing was set up. That's false copy on a money screen.
fix: In paywall.js choose the Today line by entry point: 'Everything in Pro, starting now' from Settings or Season; keep the 'next round is set up' line for the post-onboarding entry only.

issue: A card title is cut mid-sentence: 'Friends suggest a course or another game on a plan with no' ends there with no ellipsis, so it reads as a typo.
fix: Shorten the roadmap item's public title (or trim at a word boundary and add an ellipsis in the roadmap card renderer).

issue: The Black tee's swatch is a black dot with no ring, so it vanishes on the dark card. The Silver tee has no swatch selected and the swatch row has no silver.
fix: Give every tee swatch a 1px hairline ring (--line, cream at 30% in dark) and add a silver #c0c0c0 swatch.

issue: The Settings chip 'Add your home course' opens Your profile at the top. The Home course field is about a screen and a half down and the sheet doesn't open, so the tap seems to do nothing about a course.
fix: Open the Home course sheet directly from the Settings chip (or scroll to and focus the field).

issue: The body text block is centred about 23pt left of the heading's axis, so the screen looks off-centre. It's also the one failure screen with no lone-ball art, unlike every gone state.
fix: Give the error boundary's text the same centred column (max-width plus margin-inline:auto, text-align:center) as .gone-state, and reuse the loneball spot above the heading.

issue: The bottom scroll fade sits over the selected 'All the holes' segment even when scrolled to the end, smearing the selected control.
fix: Hide the sheet's scroll fade at scroll end (toggle a .at-end class from scrollTop + clientHeight >= scrollHeight - 1) and add bottom padding equal to the fade height.

issue: Off toggles have a cold mid-grey track with a dark border that sits outside the warm palette, and the Sounds note ('Your music keeps playing') is missing the final period its neighbours have.
fix: Set the off track to --line-strong (warm #e2dccf) with no border, and add the period.

issue: Banker's $2 / $1 / $10 tiles have no pencil while Nassau's $5 tiles do. The Nassau press control (Off / Manual / Auto) has no eyebrow while its siblings have STROKES GIVEN, ROTATION and TIES. The selected 'Same all round' segment fills edge to edge so its text touches the pill.
fix: Use one money-tile component with the pencil everywhere, add a PRESSES eyebrow, and give the segmented control's selected thumb 4px inset padding.

screen: Settings: Courses and edit a course
issue: 'Add a course' and 'Add tee' are dashed beige tiles with an ochre plus disc, unlike the other add rows (Add a player is an ink-plus list row). On edit, the Course name field's text is about 28px and City's about 20px in the same card.
fix: Use the shared add row (ink plus, list row) for add actions, and one input size (17px) for both fields.

issue: Game rules is 16 bare text cards with no game stickers, though the same games carry stickers on Stats and setup. The closing tee ball sits about 4pt left of the centred title under it (ball centre x 190.5pt, title 195pt).
fix: Add the 36px GameArt to each rules card, and centre the tee (it's the drawing's own box offset: trim the right padding in spots/tee.svg or nudge with translateX(4px)).

issue: This empty state sits near the top with no action, while every gone and not-found state is vertically centred with a button.
fix: Use the shared empty-state layout (centred, min-height of the scroll area) and add a 'Back to Settings' secondary button.

issue: The screen header reads 'Which ones', which isn't a screen name on its own (the back stack shows it as the title).
fix: Title it 'Notifications' and keep 'Which ones' as the section label.

issue: In the stats row the FAVORITE GAME eyebrow wraps to two lines, so 'Banker' sits about 16pt lower than '8' and '6-2' beside it. 'See all your stats' is a four-line paragraph inside a nav row. The 11.3 handicap tile and its Clear button are different heights.
fix: Shorten the eyebrow to FAVORITE (or align values with grid rows), cut the row subtitle to one line, and set the handicap tile and Clear to the same 48px height.

issue: The player card sets its numbers in a heavy grotesque, not the serif the round share card uses, with a decorative pink quarter-circle and ochre dot. Its captions are about 11pt, and there's a dead gap between the note and the buttons.
fix: Use the display serif for the card's numbers like the round card, drop the decorative shapes or swap in a spot sticker, set captions to 13px and close the gap.

issue: Choosing Only you removes the Show my money card entirely, so the page jumps and nothing says why it went.
fix: Keep the card and disable it with a one-line note ('Hidden while your profile is Only you').

issue: This sheet's radios are hollow hairline circles on cream rows, while Privacy's are filled white discs on beige rows: two radio styles in the same Settings flow. The search field has no magnifier.
fix: One shared radio row component for both, and a leading magnifier icon in the search input.

issue: It says '16 games' while the paywall and onboarding say 22, and 'Add it to your Home Screen' sits in straight double quotes where the app uses curly ones.
fix: Update the What's new entry to the current game count and use curly quotes.

issue: Every vote box shows 0, and in the serif the 0 reads like a letter O down a column of 17 cards. Apostrophes are mixed (straight in trip's and page's, curly in what's).
fix: Show the bare up arrow with 'Vote' when the count is 0, and run roadmap titles through the curly-quote helper.

issue: 'Open the app' sits where the back button goes elsewhere, and the title is plain text with no logo lockup (the plan and join links use the ball logo and wordmark). The 'Got an idea?' row uses a ball on a tee here and a bulb in the app, and its copy leaves 'one in' as an orphan.
fix: Use the public-link header from the plan link (logo lockup left, action right), the bulb spot on both and text-wrap:pretty on the card copy.

issue: The textarea shows the browser's resize grip in the corner, and Send looks fully enabled while the box is empty.
fix: Add resize:none to the suggest textarea and the disabled button style until there's text.

issue: The 'Not on the list' tile has a thicker border and a different fill from the name tiles beside it, and after tapping In the date chip splits 'Sun' and 'Nov 8' onto two lines.
fix: Give 'Not on the list' the shared tile style with a dashed hairline, and white-space:nowrap on the date chip.

issue: The two text links under the buttons ('Just keep my own score' and 'Not now') sit at uneven gaps and weights, so they read as stray lines rather than a pair.
fix: Put them in one centred row separated by a middle dot, or stack them at the same 12px gap in the shared text-link style.

issue: 'Round not found' appears twice (round gone and play gone) with different copy and different buttons, and the join-link one has no header back button while the others do.
fix: One GoneState per kind with shared copy, and always show the header back (or a 'Back to Up next' button) on not-found links.

issue: The page background is a different cream (rgb 248,242,228) from the app's (249,245,236), the wordmark is plain text, and 'Check again' is cut at the viewport bottom with no padding below it.
fix: Use var(--bg) on the status page body, the logo lockup from the plan link, and padding-bottom: calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)).

issue: The toast sits over the row it's about, covering its label.
fix: Lift the toast above the tab bar safe area with bottom: calc(var(--tabbar-h) + 12px), or offset it while a list row sits under it.

issue: The empty state (sleeping ball) explains there's no plan but offers no action, while the same app has a paywall to start a trial.
fix: Add a secondary 'See Pro' button under the empty copy that opens the paywall.
